title: Amazing Italian Lemon Butter Chicken
description: This lemon butter chicken recipe combines thin strips of chicken breast in a delicious, rich sauce with bacon, mushrooms, artichoke hearts, and capers; served over pasta.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - pounded to 1/4 inch thickness
6 ounces artichoke hearts, drained and halved

steps.text: To make the sauce, pour wine and lemon juice into a saucepan over medium heat. Cook at a low boil until the liquid is reduced by 1/3. Stir in cream, and simmer until it thickens. Gradually add butter, 1 tablespoon at a time to the sauce, stirring until completely incorporated. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat, and keep warm.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil. Add pasta, and cook until al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. Drain, and set aside.

To make the chicken, heat oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. In a bowl, stir together flour, salt, and pepper. Lightly coat chicken with flour mixture. Without crowding, carefully place chicken in hot oil. If necessary, cook in batches. Fry until cooked through and golden brown on both sides. Remove chicken to paper towels. Stir bacon, mushrooms, artichokes, and capers into the pan; cook until mushrooms are soft.
Cut chicken breasts into bite-size strips, and return them to the skillet. Stir 1/2 of the lemon butter sauce into the chicken mixture.
To serve, place pasta in a large bowl. Stir the chicken mixture into the pasta. Taste, and adjust seasonings. Stir in additional lemon butter sauce as desired. Toss well, and garnish with parsley.

video.description: A lemon butter sauce with a splash of white wine complements this chicken dish studded with bacon, mushrooms, artichoke hearts and capers. Serve over pasta and you've got an easy meal elegant enough for company!
